scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 lacks these APIs, hence FS0039
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, methodical investigation despite early path/tool friction; recovered by querying the binlog directly. Output pinpoints a single root cause with evidence, explains cascade mechanism, identifies the unconditioned Compile items, offers a concrete fix, and separates residual genuine errors.
